items.difficulty_reason: Derived direct sums and products in D(A, d): uses that Mod(A,d) is abelian with arbitrary sums and products and that these descend to the homotopy category (two structural lemmas), then computes Hom from a test object out of the direct sum, and closes with the align* chain identifying products in the homotopy category with products of derived Hom sets, giving part (3). Retained author proof at lines 4565-4619.
